contract: H4 kb snapshot: POST /v1/kb/snapshot, a factory's whole kb from its --role forward to Hestia (hestia 0011; card kb-snapshot-budget)
rule: ~/agent-slack/specs/contracts/README.md: a contract change edits this file first; both sides' tests read it

writers.code: internal/forward forward.go kbTick and sendKB; internal/kb Snapshot, EncodeSnapshot, GzipSnapshot

readers.code: internal/handler kb_snapshot_handler.go postKBSnapshot; internal/kb DecodeSnapshot, ReplaceSnapshot; /kb/freshness?factory=

vendored: record keeps a copy at specs/contracts/kb-snapshot.json; internal/model TestContractCopyMatchesAgentSlack fails when they differ

limits.notes: max_body_bytes bounds the body as it travels (gzip when Content-Encoding: gzip); max_snapshot_bytes bounds the plain JSON once inflated; warn_at is the fraction of the binding cap past which the forwarder's size line is a warning and factory check warns

version_field.is: sha256, lowercase hex, of the snapshot encoded (encoding/json, the field order below) with index.version empty

also.index.kb_commit: kb_index_state git:main last_commit_sha at the sender, empty where it indexes no knowledge repo (working-on documents carry commit_sha nogit)
also.index.indexed_at: the latest documents[].indexed_at, null without documents

version_field.absent: a sender older than kb-snapshot-budget sends no index; the receiver accepts the snapshot and stores an empty version
version_field.answered_by: GET /kb/freshness?factory=<f> -> snapshot.index_version, snapshot.kb_commit, snapshot.indexed_at, snapshot.accepted_at (epoch ms)

not_validated: node type, node status and edge rel have no enum at the receiver; an edge's ends need not be nodes (migrations/0005_kb.sql, no FK)
